source.note: Hash is of the CORRECTED source claim, which at fetch time had not yet reached the implementation's main branch. --verify-sources will therefore report divergence until it does. That is the intended behaviour: the check goes green when the two are actually the same, not when someone asserts they are.

This registry entry is the source of record. The implementation is a static site and publishes no machine-readable claim file, so there is nothing to point at and nothing that can diverge. Declared rather than left blank so a reviewer can see the difference between 'no external source exists' and 'nobody filled this in'.

withdrawn.reason: The claim was withdrawn rather than corrected in place: its levels were not derived from an assessment, so no edit to them would have been evidence-based either. Re-issue after a real assessment against the schema's evidence form.
